cards.title: One pipeline, three entry points
items: Frontend REST/SSE, Voice webhooks, and the Roleplay simulator all call the same PipelineRunner
No channel has its own response path — FAST_PATH/FULL_PATH routing happens once, inside the pipeline

cards.title: Short-lived DB sessions
items: Memory, knowledge, and store nodes open brief sessions via session_factory
No connection is held across the LLM-heavy nodes, so concurrency doesn't starve Postgres
The Learning Pipeline also writes moves/expressions/insights back to the same PostgreSQL instance, asynchronously

cards.title: Configurable LLM providers
items: OpenAI runs the cheap gpt-4o-mini analyzer calls and can serve as primary with priority-tier service
Anthropic is the other configurable primary-response provider, resolved per agent_version_id
